org.chromium.components.browser_ui.setti.android:summary: Import and restore all profiles and settings from a previously saved backup file
Backups are protected using AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation. Saved files can be restored across different Android devices or stored securely on an SD card or USB flash drive.
